core_obligations: Choose the affine open with a standard smooth presentation (proof lines 8562-8564).
Write the coordinate ring as a quotient by the standard smooth equations (proof lines 8565-8580).
Exhibit the projection to an affine space and the etale morphism, and check the diagram (proof lines 8581-8598).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism which is smooth at a point becomes, after passing to an affine open neighbourhood of the point inside the preimage of a given affine open of the target, a composite of an etale morphism with the projection from an affine space. The statement carries a slogan summarising this local structure. The proof uses the characterisation of smoothness at a point through the standard smooth presentation, writes the coordinate ring of the chosen affine open as a quotient of a polynomial algebra over the base by the standard smooth equations, and then exhibits the projection to an affine space together with the induced etale morphism described by the presentation.
